title: Common-task online state frontier
hypothesis: On heldout tasks from a shared low-rank-plus-residual linear family, a support-adapted latent state can reach comparable quality with less complete serialized state than full Hebbian/Delta matrices; Mirror-specific value requires beating CAVIA-style context and native low-rank updates.
physical_object: Per-task linear function delta from shared mean model
mirror_coordinate: Low-dimensional code over a train-task-derived shared basis
logical_multiplicity: Task-specific functions from shared model plus writable state
controls: CAVIA-style latent context with support-gradient updates

development.selection_metric: mean heldout random-query nRMSE on the same 32 support and 128 query examples/task; tune rates on development only

paid_objects: per-task context or writable state bank

success_gate: Fresh methods must be compared at the same support budget; report quality/complete bytes/online compute. Mirror-specific claim requires paired improvement over CAVIA-style and native low-rank controls at matched state bytes and measured compute.
failure_gate: Mirror aliases or is dominated by native/CAVIA context methods at matched budgets, or loses quality at equal actual bytes.
boundaries: Single synthetic linear task subfamily, not a general adaptation frontier or reproduced CAVIA benchmark.
Hidden teachers are A=A0+U*C*V^T+sigma*R; A0 and basis are fitted only from a separate train-task set via support observations. Hidden U,V,C*,A and query labels remain evaluator-only.
CAVIA-style uses actual support-gradient context updates but no outer-loop meta-training; its name denotes a proxy.
Fresh tasks use independent whole-task seeds 73 and 89 and are never used for tuning.

amendments.reason: Before any runs, Astra review rejected identity support and teacher-basis leakage.
changes: Keep teacher A, hidden generators and query labels in evaluator.
Fit shared mean and decoder only from a separate support-observed train-task bank.
Use actual support-gradient steps for the CAVIA-style proxy; compare full Hebb/Delta, projected Delta, and support-only ridge.
amendments.fresh_policy: No data accessed before this amendment.

amendments.reason: After the protocol and rates were frozen, independent review found serialized metadata and live/snapshot state accounting needed normalization; reset also needed same-object verification.
changes: Use method-independent serialized schema metadata so method names do not affect payload byte comparisons.
Report float64 live writable state bytes separately from float32 serialized snapshot-state bytes.
Reuse one state object and clear it in place between tasks.
Correct executed-operation MAC proxies for full Delta, projected Delta, ridge and query decoding; record shared-basis training cost separately.
amendments.fresh_policy: Fresh tasks were accessed after frozen development rates. Deterministic replay corrects accounting/reset checks only; no tuning or method selection changed.
